vikisozluk.baslik: لَحْوَجَ • (laḥwaja) Iq (non-past يُلَحْوِجُ (yulaḥwiju), verbal noun لَحْوَجَة (laḥwaja))
etim_sablon: ل ح و ج (l ḥ w j)
anlam: to mix, to blend, to knead
to garble, to fabricate, to pervert
